function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the public record on Conti ransomware as a ransomware-as-a-service operation, using only high-quality public sources that you can return with explicit source IDs. Prioritize original Conti chat leaks and other direct leak materials, United States Department of Justice or Federal Bureau of Investigation records, court documents or indictments, Treasury sanctions, official government advisories, and original technical or investigative reports when primary records are unavailable. Cover: (1) how sources characterize Conti's RaaS model, including operators, affiliates, access brokers, negotiators, developers, money laundering or payment roles, and division of labor; (2) what the 2022 Conti leaks and related disclosures reveal about internal organization, job roles, workflows, victim handling, communications, recruitment, infrastructure, payments, and affiliate relationships, while clearly stating what leaks can and cannot establish; (3) chronology of major disclosures, attacks, disruptions, sanctions, indictments, arrests, or other enforcement actions; (4) specific aliases and any links to named individuals, defendants, organizations, or jurisdictions, with the exact evidentiary basis for each alias-to-person and person-to-Conti connection; and (5) disagreements, inconsistent identities, allegations, governmental assessments, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not infer beyond the sources. For every material statement provide the source ID(s) supplied by your research system, and distinguish documented facts, allegations, investigative or governmental assessments, and uncertainty. Return a structured evidence memo suitable for a later writer, with source IDs and enough source metadata to identify them."}
function.name: ConductResearch
